Why do bad things happen to good people? Kevin has an answer.

Kevin Trudeau says people ask how he could have wanted what happened to him. His answer is that they don't know what he was really asking for.

He explains that being held away let him clear his businesses and start with a clean slate for his mission. He sees the hardest thing in his life as the thing that served him.

When did something that felt like a disaster turn out to be the best thing for you?

#ad #mindset #success

You were not born doubting yourself. You were taught to.

Kevin Trudeau shares what his friend Zig Ziglar used to say: everyone is born to win, but conditioned to lose.

He lists the things we heard as kids. Stop that. You're not smart enough. Who do you think you are? Kevin says that programming sticks around.

His answer is to get rid of it and replace it with positive programming.

What is one thing you were told as a child that you still hear in your head?

#ad #mindset #success

Two people each said their own mother drove them crazy. Neither could see it.

Kevin Trudeau tells the story of visiting his girlfriend's mother. He found her wonderful, though his girlfriend had warned him she was impossible. A month later the girlfriend visited his mother, and the two got along like peas and carrots.

His conclusion was that it wasn't his mother and it wasn't her mother. It was the relationship each of them had with their own mother.

Which relationship in your life would feel different if you changed how you show up?

#ad #love #relationships

Your closest friends may be shaping you more than you think.

Kevin Trudeau explains that people carry different energy. Some have a negative, toxic vibration, and others have a positive, uplifting one.

He says that if you spend time with winners and upbeat, like-minded people, it rubs off on you. He jokes that when he talks about the five people you spend the most time with, listeners tell him they need new friends.

His advice is simple: hang around positive, motivated people.

Who in your circle makes you feel like you can do more?

#ad #success #habits

Why does your voice sound strange on a recording? Kevin explains.

Kevin Trudeau says that when you speak, only a small part of the sound travels through the air to your ear. Most of it travels through the bone in your head, which is why a recording sounds different.

So when you say something like I can do this or I'm a winner, he says it vibrates through your whole body, not just your brain.

He calls your own words the easiest and fastest way to program yourself for success.

What is the first thing you say to yourself each morning?

#ad #mindset #success

Jim Carrey pictured success every morning, even when rent was a struggle.

Kevin Trudeau tells the story of Jim Carrey, who put a picture of a big check made out to himself on the ceiling. Every morning he looked at it and saw himself getting a starting payment to be in a movie.

He did this with no job, living in a studio apartment.

Kevin says this is just one technique and just one ingredient of the whole recipe.

What would you picture first thing every morning?

#ad #goals #success

Magicians have said one word for centuries that most people misunderstand.

Kevin Trudeau says what you say is actually what you get. He explains that abracadabra comes from an ancient Persian word, which he translates as I now create with my words.

It turns a stage trick into a reminder that words are not just noise. They are how you build what comes next.

What is one sentence you would stop saying about yourself?

#ad #mindset #habits

A vinyl record changed how a struggling salesman thought.

Kevin Trudeau tells how Earl Nightingale made a record called The Strangest Secret. Its core idea is that you become what you think about most of the time, and that thoughts are things.

He then describes a movie scene with the founder of McDonald's, Ray Kroc. Kroc was struggling to sell milkshake mixers and played a record like that every morning in motels.

The message he played to himself was that perseverance is the most important attribute to success.

What do you listen to first thing in the morning?

#ad #success #mindset

hook: The Club That Changed Family Love
clips.caption:
What happens when you spend two hours around people who only lift you up?

Kevin Trudeau describes a club where everyone smiled, shook hands, praised each other and gave compliments. People left feeling different.

He shares a story of a parent who came home beaming. For the first time in a month, the kids ran up to hug them.

The parent's reaction was to ask who these kids were and where their own kids had gone.

Who around you could use a sincere compliment today?

#ad #love #happiness
